description: Single AIQ tag → one atomic edit: done-mark + %ANSWER comment below

tags_json.content: should this be in display math instead?
tags_json.anchor: The potential is $V = x^4$.  %AIQ: should this be in display math instead?

expected_behavior: Single Edit replacing the anchor line: %AIQ: becomes %(done)AIQ: and a %ANSWER: line is inserted immediately below it. Answer is concise (1-3 lines). No AI-answer environment used. Edit oldText is the anchor string, not a line number.

tags_json.content: explain why we use discrete energy levels here
tags_json.anchor: The energy levels are $E_n$.  %AIQ(render): explain why we use discrete energy levels here

expected_behavior: Single Edit replacing the anchor line: %(done)AIQ(render): plus \begin{AI-answer}...\end{AI-answer} below. Answer is LaTeX prose (not a brief comment). Checks if AI-answer env is defined in root file and adds it (teal #1F6F8B) if missing.
